title: Layer 2 round 1 major SE: every Command spawn error maps to Unreachable, swapping the degraded kind
description: acquire.rs:91 — Err(_) => Unreachable => Absent (offline). But PermissionDenied (exec bit lost), spawn-resource failures, a nonexistent current_dir are NOT offline; a chmod-broken chassis reports tracker-absent forever instead of tracker-unusable — defeating degraded-kinds-are-never-swapped upstream of the derivation the fixtures pin. Disposition: match e.kind(): only NotFound is Unreachable, every other spawn error is Failed/unusable. Owner: software-engineer. Validator: security.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: the acquisition arms classify through the bounded runner — only a binary missing from PATH is the offline shape (Absent); spawn failure, timeout, oversize, refused, and unparseable output are all Unusable. The swap is structurally impossible now: the match arms name the outcomes.
